title: Planner: save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and the documented Planner Agent licence and access controls. Searches confirmed the narrower gaps concerning saved filters, including their default availability, storage and separate controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let users save AI-generated filters from Planner Agent chat for reuse on their plans.
claims.quote: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat. Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

It gives PowerShell; its admin-centre link concerns Planner Agent in Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration supports -AllowPlannerCopilot with $true or $false and -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId with a security group ID.
claims.quote: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: Get-PlannerConfiguration verifies the access settings and returns AllowPlannerCopilot and PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId.
